title: Frontend Developer
description: Learn how to build beautiful, responsive, and high-performance user interfaces. This path takes you from basic internet concepts to modern framework engineering.

nodes.title: Internet Basics
nodes.description: Understand how the web works, hosting, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and browsers.

resources.title: How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes

projectIdeas: Deploy a simple static text page using GitHub Pages and map it to a custom sub-domain.
interviewQuestions: What happens when you type a URL in your browser and hit Enter?
Explain the difference between HTTP and HTTPS.

nodes.title: Semantic HTML
nodes.description: Learn structuring web documents using correct semantic tags for SEO and accessibility.
projectIdeas: Create a semantic markup mockup of a blog article with side panels, navigation links, and article bodies.
interviewQuestions: Why should you use semantic tags like <main>, <article>, <section> instead of just <div>?
What is the purpose of the alt attribute on images?

nodes.title: CSS Styles & Responsive Layouts
nodes.description: Master Flexbox, Grid layouts, custom variables, responsive media queries, and design patterns.
projectIdeas: Build a fully responsive pricing page card grid matching mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
interviewQuestions: Explain the difference between flexbox and CSS Grid and when to use each.
What is the CSS Box Model?

nodes.title: JavaScript & DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Learn async programming, promises, array methods, API integration, and standard browser DOM APIs.
projectIdeas: Build a dynamic Todo List with LocalStorage cache and drag-and-drop ordering.
interviewQuestions: What is event delegation in JavaScript?
What is the difference between let, const, and var?

nodes.title: Git & Version Control
nodes.description: Learn how to manage version history, commit branches, merge changes, and collaborate using GitHub.
projectIdeas: Initialize a Git repository, create a dev branch, make changes, resolve a mock merge conflict, and push to GitHub.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between git merge and git rebase?

nodes.title: React Library core concepts
nodes.description: Understand Virtual DOM, hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useContext), props, and component lifecycle.
projectIdeas: Build an interactive Dashboard with filters, search fields, and details modal views.
interviewQuestions: How does the virtual DOM work in React?
When does a React component re-render?

nodes.title: Next.js App Router
nodes.description: Master React Server Components (RSC), Client Components, server-side data fetching, page routing, and SEO optimization.
projectIdeas: Create a Server-Side Rendered Blog with dynamic routing, pre-fetching tags, and responsive design systems.
interviewQuestions: Explain the difference between Server Components and Client Components in Next.js.
What is the difference between ISR and SSR?
